name: bookkeeping-kit
description: Source + generator + tests for Bookkeeping for Xero and the Bookkeeping checks for MYOB / QuickBooks extensions (mysmb-marketplace).

scripts.gen: node gen-ext.js ../.. && node gen-ext.js ../.. myob && node gen-ext.js ../.. quickbooks
scripts.check: tsx check.mts ../.. && tsx check.mts ../.. bookkeeping-myob && tsx check.mts ../.. bookkeeping-quickbooks
scripts.pycheck: tsx pycheck.mts ../.. && tsx pycheck.mts ../.. bookkeeping-myob && tsx pycheck.mts ../.. bookkeeping-quickbooks
